summary: Consume deferred replay requirements when an authorized automatic full repair succeeds.

replay.detail: With complete discovery and no graph-projecting conflict in the replay range, a successful automatic full replay clears the deferred-replay row in the same transaction that restores graph health. Graph-projecting conflicts still defer automatic replay.

rules.detail: Canonical operation and graph rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No claim or wire format changes.

manual.detail: Explicit full repair retains its existing deferred-row cleanup.

recovery.detail: Completing a conflict-free rediscovery requires at most one automatic full repair rather than repeating full replay on every later catch-up.

downtime.detail: No production timing measurement is claimed.
